articles.title: Oracle Issues Emergency Java Update for Critical 9.1 HTTPS Trust Vulnerability
articles.summary:
Oracle has released an emergency Java security update to address CVE-2026-91403, a critical vulnerability affecting how Java applications trust digital certificates. Published on October 21, 2026, the alert assigns the flaw a CVSS 3.1 score of 9.1 and covers Oracle Java SE and GraalVM. The update blocks affected intermediate certificate authority certificates linked to eMudhra. […]

articles.title: PwC Data Breach Claim – Everest Ransomware Group Claims to Have Stolen 590 GB of Data
articles.summary:
The Everest ransomware group claims to have stolen 590.69 GB of data from PwC, the global professional services firm. This alleged data theft includes human resources records, training materials, and internal documents. However, the claims are unverified, and PwC has not yet responded. The group’s listing was reported on October 22, 2026. Hackmanac’s public alert […]
